newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Missing German girl found dead near Amsterdam.
newsitem.headline: Missing German girl found dead near Amsterdam.

text.p: A dead body found near Amsterdam has been identified as missing 10-year-old German girl Kim Kerkow, Dutch police said on Saturday.
A police spokesman said the body was found on Friday by two passers-by walking in woodlands on the outskirts of the city.
"The body was found in a recreation area on Friday but only identified today," he said, adding that an investigation, led by German authorities, was in progress.
In a statement police said Kerkow, from Varel in northern Germany, had been missing from her house since Thursday evening.
Since the alarm was raised, some five hundred soldiers and two hundred police have been involved in the search for her.
